action_unavailable: {action} is unavailable because the host did not provide its callback.
add_slide_from_library: Add slide from the slide library
added_unpinned: Added {name}, but it could not be pinned. Publication needs a pinned photograph — use "Pin now" once it is reachable.
adjustments_note: Display only. These change what you see, never the measurements — those come from scanner metadata.
annotations_empty: Nothing marked yet. Pick a tool above — M measures a distance, C places a counting frame of known area.
asset_disabled_failed: This slide could not be imported.
asset_disabled_importing: This slide is still being imported.
asset_disabled_needs_calibration: Verified scanner calibration is required before this slide can be added.
block_note: A paraffin block belongs to exactly one specimen part.
calibrate_note: This file carries no scanner optics. Every measurement a reader makes is scaled by these two numbers, so they are asked for rather than assumed.
cannot_resolve_reference: This host cannot resolve referenced content, so the photograph cannot be fetched to pin it.
choose_gross_for_case: Choose gross photographs for this case
classification_title: What the next annotation is called
clear_hint: Delete every annotation on this slide (undoable)
clinical_metadata_note: Public context every learner sees. Protected answers and hints live in the activity rubric.
counting_frame_place: Place a {area} mm² frame — WHO reports counts per mm², not per 10 HPF
drop_photographs_note: JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP, straight from your camera or phone. Large photographs are resized to fit inside the case.
existing_dzi_note: Every calibration field is required. Case Studio will not guess scanner optics.
field_area_hint: Area of tissue currently on screen
frame_count_disagrees: {marks, plural, one {# marker} other {# markers}} placed inside this frame — the counter says {tally}.
gross_and_slide_counts: {gross, plural, other {# gross}} · {slides, plural, one {# slide} other {# slides}}
gross_card_note: Macroscopic photographs, shown to the learner as a contact sheet in the order below.
gross_card_note_part: Macroscopic photographs of this part, shown to the learner as a contact sheet in the order below.
gross_description_note: what the specimen looked like, in words
gross_empty_multipart: No gross photograph yet. Add photograph attaches one to a specimen part.
gross_empty_part: No gross photograph yet. The learner opens the Gross tab and finds this part empty.
gross_empty_solo: No gross photograph yet. The learner opens the Gross tab and finds it empty.
gross_none_for_case: No gross specimen has been photographed for this case.
gross_none_for_part: No gross photograph was taken of {part}.
histology_empty: No slide yet. A block is created automatically with your first slide — add one yourself only when you want to name it.
histology_note: Scanned slides for this part. Each is filed under a block — the piece of tissue it was cut from.
import_failed: That file could not be imported: {reason}
import_from_link_note: Paste a link to a whole-slide image (.svs, .ndpi, .tiff). It is downloaded, tiled and added to this library. Only hosts your administrator has allowed can be used.
insert_measurements: Insert {count, plural, one {# measurement} other {# measurements}}
interpolated_hint: Digitally enlarged beyond the scanned resolution
keymap_count_increment: Add one to the selected count
label: Label
no_asset_service: No asset service is configured. Add an existing DZI manually below.
no_material: No pathology material is attached to this case.
no_slide_yet: No slide yet. Choose one from the slide library.
objective_unreachable: {power}x is beyond this archive — it would be interpolated, not resolved
one_specimen_note: This case is one specimen. Add a second part only if the accession really had one — a lymph node alongside a resection, say.
path_or_address_hint: A path such as gross/case42/a-fresh.jpg names a photograph kept with your slides — the case points at it and stays small. A full https:// address is used as written.
pathology_summary_mixed: {slides, plural, one {# slide} other {# slides}}, {photographs, plural, one {# photograph} other {# photographs}}
pathology_summary_photographs: {count, plural, one {# gross photograph} other {# gross photographs}}
pin_unpinned: Not pinned — publication will be blocked
plate_no_scale: No scale declared for this plate
plate_width_hint: Optional — fill this in to give the learner a scale bar.
plate_width_set: Scale bar is live in the room.
preview_blocked_no_slide: Preview blocked: add a slide first.
preview_isolated: Events and work are isolated and will not be saved.
protected_rubric_note: Never included in a learner package.
reading_photographs: Reading {count, plural, one {# photograph} other {# photographs}}…
referenced_photograph_note: Not previewable here. It loads wherever this case is served.
report_body_placeholder: Describe what you examined and what you found, then state your conclusion.
report_summary: {words, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}{findings, plural, =0 {} other { · # findings}}
reports_empty: No report yet. Add report opens a blank one — give it a title, write your findings, then save it as a draft or submit it.
rois_empty: Add each finding the learner must resolve.
room_pathology_sub: Read a whole slide under the microscope
scan_needs_service: Scanning requires a configured asset service.
scanner_calibration_note: what every measurement in the room is derived from
shortcuts_typing_note: Shortcuts are ignored while you are typing in a text box, so a diagnosis can contain the letter r without drawing a rectangle.
slide_library_note: Preview a verified slide, then add it to this case.
slide_note: Its label and stain are what the learner sees.
slides_across_blocks: {slides, plural, one {# slide} other {# slides}} across {blocks, plural, other {# blocks}}.
slides_card_empty: Whole-slide scans the learner reads under the microscope.
slides_cut_from_block: {count, plural, one {# slide is} other {# slides are}} cut from this block.
snapshot_hint: Save this field as a PNG, scale bar included
studio_no_onchange: This host did not provide an onChange callback.
submit_blocked_already_submitted: This report has already been submitted.
submit_blocked_no_body: The report has no findings written in it yet.
submit_blocked_no_report: There is no report to submit.
submit_blocked_no_title: Give the report a title before submitting it.
submit_note: A submitted report is locked and time-stamped. Saving keeps it editable.
title: Title
tool_polygon: Polygon — click vertices, Enter to close
tool_polyline: Free-form path — measures along the curve
